title: Trace of the constant-word writer
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $x,w$ be finite words over a symbol type, choose a work-tape index $i<k$, and let $d$ be a configuration with write phases indexed by the length of $w$. If $d$ is initially in the writing state at position $0$, then at every time $t\in\mathbb N$ the writer's configuration equals the following piecewise trace: the forward writing configuration at time $t$ when $t\le |w|$; the return configuration indexed by $2|w|+1-t$ when $|w|<t\le 2|w|+1$; and the designated done configuration when $t>2|w|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is in the writing state at position $0$
